evidence: The structural properties, morphology, and residual C content in the films were analyzed by x-ray diffraction (XRD), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), respectively. A cross section and local cation composition of a PbTiOx film deposited on a 3D substrate were analyzed by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) combined with energy dispersive x-ray (EDX) spectroscopy.
